objective: Review the public-facing project status UI and propose one small, low-risk improvement. Do not claim to inspect the live site unless evidence is included in the task.
constraints: Proposal only: never apply files, merge, or deploy.
Do not change secrets, workflows, credentials, or deployment configuration.
Do not invent test results or claim browser checks were run.
Keep the proposal small and explain the expected benefit.
success_criteria: Every proposed file is within public/.
Return a concise summary and evidence limitations.
Independent checker must review scope and unsupported claims.
